title: Predicting phase transitions across temperature, pressure, and chemical potential using exponentially tilted thermodynamic maps.
authors: Lee, Suemin; Wang, Ruiyu; Herron, Lukas; Tiwary, Pratyush
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于统计物理和生成式AI的指数倾斜热力学图框架，用于在任意热力学条件下生成不同相样本，虽以晶格气体和CO2为对象，但其生成式采样方法可迁移至蛋白质构象采样与相变研究。
abstract: Predicting and characterizing phase transitions is crucial for understanding generic physical phenomena such as crystallization, protein folding, and others. However, directly observing phase transitions is not always easy, and we often have limited observations far from the phase boundary, measured under specific thermodynamic conditions. In this study, we propose a statistical-physics- and generative-AI-driven framework that uses such limited information to generate samples of different phases under arbitrary thermodynamic conditions, which we call Exponentially Tilted Thermodynamic Maps (expTM). The central idea is to map collected data into a simple, tractable prior expressed as an exponentially tilted Gaussian. We demonstrate how the variance and mean of the prior can be correlated with pairs of thermodynamic control variables, including temperature, pressure, and chemical potential. This gives us the ability to generate thermodynamically correct samples under any values of the control variables. To demonstrate the practical applicability of this approach, we use expTM to sample a lattice gas model with the grand canonical ensemble, capturing phase transitions under varying chemical potentials and temperatures. We further demonstrate how expTM can model the isothermal-isobaric ensemble, with which we predict different phases of CO(2) under varying pressure conditions. Both examples are trained on very limited data far from the phase boundary. These results establish expTM as a robust tool for understanding phase transitions across diverse thermodynamic conditions requiring only a small number of observations.
abstract_zh: 预测和表征相变对于理解诸如结晶、蛋白质折叠等一般物理现象至关重要。然而，直接观察相变并不总是容易的，我们往往只能在远离相边界的有限观测中，在特定热力学条件下进行测量。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于统计物理和生成式人工智能的框架，利用这些有限信息在任意热力学条件下生成不同相的样本，我们称之为指数倾斜热力学映射（Exponentially Tilted Thermodynamic Maps, expTM）。核心思想是将收集到的数据映射到一个简单、易处理的先验分布上，该分布表示为指数倾斜的高斯分布。我们展示了先验的方差和均值如何与热力学控制变量对（包括温度、压力和化学势）相关联。这使我们能够在任意控制变量值下生成热力学上正确的样本。为展示该方法的实际应用性，我们使用expTM对巨正则系综下的晶格气体模型进行采样，捕捉不同化学势和温度下的相变。我们进一步展示了expTM如何模拟等温等压系综，并据此预测CO(2)在不同压力条件下的不同相。两个示例均在远离相边界的极有限数据上训练。这些结果确立了expTM作为一种稳健工具，能够在多样热力学条件下理解相变，且仅需少量观测数据。
